scope: Shared formal library only: the seven modules in formal/ValyuResearch. This replay checks those 153 audited declarations (96 named theorems and 57 compiler-generated helpers) and their full proof dependencies. It does not formalize the manuscripts' other claims; see docs/formal-coverage.md for each paper's Lean scope. The separate determinant package is not part of this replay.
